name: reverse sliding leg curl on floor with towel
description: A hamstring curl on a towel where you slide the heels away and pull them back. It is a challenging bodyweight hamstring move.
instructions: Lie on your back with your heels on a towel on a smooth floor.
Lift your hips into a bridge.
Slide your feet away from you by extending the knees.
Pull the heels back toward your hips with your hamstrings.
Keep your hips high the whole set.
Lower to the floor when you finish.
